fields.quoted_span: a landlord shall not demand or receive security, however denominated, in an amount or value in excess of an amount equal to one month’s rent, in addition to any rent for the first month paid on or before initial occupancy.
fields.note: The requirement's elements are each found in the statute: the cap, the definition of security, the six-month advance payment, the small-landlord cap and its service-member exception, deductions, inspections, photographs, 21-day return, the $125 and 14-day request rules, electronic return, successor liability, the ban on 'nonrefundable', and bad-faith damages. The 'Security includes ... advance rent' wording matches subd. (b).

fields.quoted_span: a landlord shall not demand or receive security, however denominated, in an amount or value in excess of an amount equal to one month’s rent, in addition to any rent for the first month paid on or before initial occupancy.
fields.note: The 1-month and 2-month caps, the service-member exclusion, the 21-day return with itemized statement, the $125 threshold and the up-to-2x bad-faith damages all appear in the text. The $125 waiver is subject to a tenant request within 14 days, which the key value reflects with 'unless requested'.

fields.quoted_span: This subdivision shall not apply to a security collected or demanded by the landlord before July 1, 2024.
fields.note: The July 1, 2024 start for the cap is supported by subd. (c)(6). The later dates (April 1, 2025; July 1, 2025) and the Jan. 1, 2026 amendment are also in the text. The pre-July 2024 caps in the note come from outside the document and are not verifiable here.

fields.quoted_span: (Amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 340, Sec. 1.   (AB 414)   Effective January 1, 2026.)
fields.note: The text shows the current version as amended and effective Jan. 1, 2026, with no repeal or sunset. This is consistent with in_force.

fields.quoted_span: This section applies to security for a rental agreement for residential property that is used as the dwelling of the tenant.
fields.note: The scope is statewide residential dwellings. The small-landlord conditions (natural person or all-natural-person LLC, no more than two properties and four units), the service-member exclusion and the pre-July 2024 exception are all in the text. The family-trust inclusion also matches.

The section is Civ. Code § 1950.5, in Chapter 2 (Hiring of Real Property), and was amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 340 (AB 414). The aliases AB 414 and Stats. 2025, ch. 340 match. AB 12 is not mentioned in the document, but that does not affect the primary citation.
